reasons: Cited paragraph p0001 expressly states that nothing creates an exclusive arrangement and that the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties, directly supporting the preferred position of no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer.

Rationale correctly characterizes remaining 'exclusive' usages (non-exclusive license to Customer, exclusive jurisdiction, trademark ownership, third-party beneficiary limits) as non-deviations under the detection guidance.
Consistent with a compliant status: no redline text was altered and no counterparty comment was added; deterministic check confirming no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer passed.
